meaning_by_symbol.HUM: Sound a sustained tone near all six faces simultaneously for the specified duration, starting from the specified face, at the specified intensity. Let the tone fade naturally and wait for the hum to stabilize.
meaning_by_symbol.ROT-HUM: Rotate slowly over the specified duration while sounding a steady tone at the specified intensity near opposite faces, starting from the specified face. After rotation, chime the bell once near each corner.
meaning_by_symbol.CLOTH-EDGE: Drape a folded cloth over the specified face for the specified duration at the specified intensity or coverage. Then chime a bell near each edge of the specified face twice.
meaning_by_symbol.CORNER-WARM: Warm each corner of the specified face by holding a heated stone nearby for the specified duration at the specified intensity or warmth, in sequence. Then trace each edge of the specified face with a finger.
meaning_by_symbol.CORNER-CHIME-WARM: At each corner of the specified face, chime a bell briefly at the specified intensity or tone, then warm the two edges meeting at that corner with a heated stone for the specified duration.
meaning_by_symbol.BOARD-PAIR: Rest a flat board against the specified face at the specified intensity or contact for the specified duration. Rotate and repeat for each face-pair.
meaning_by_symbol.CENTER-CHIME-STONE: Chime a bell near the center of each face once at the specified intensity or tone, starting from the specified face. Then place a warm stone beside the Veyru for the specified duration.
meaning_by_symbol.STONE-ROT: Place a warm stone beside the specified face at the specified intensity or warmth for the specified duration. Rotate and repeat for each face.
meaning_by_symbol.REST: Place the Veyru on a soft surface with the specified face up at the specified intensity or contact. Let it rest undisturbed for the specified duration.
meaning_by_symbol.ALT-CHIME: Chime a bell near two opposite faces, starting from the specified face. Alternate the chime between the two faces with the specified duration as the pause between chimes, for five cycles at the specified intensity or tone.
meaning_by_symbol.FAN-PAIR: Drape a cool cloth over the Veyru for the specified duration. Remove the cloth and fan cool air at the specified intensity across the specified face and the opposite face for the specified duration.
meaning_by_symbol.FAN-ALL: Drape a cool cloth over the Veyru for the specified duration. Remove the cloth and fan cool air at the specified intensity across all six faces for the specified duration, starting from the specified face.
meaning_by_symbol.LAMP-OPP: Illuminate the specified face with a dim lamp and the opposite face with a bright lamp simultaneously at the specified intensity or brightness for the specified duration, without moving the lamps.
meaning_by_symbol.CLOTH-2EDGE: Drape a cloth over two adjacent edges near the specified face for the specified duration at the specified intensity or coverage. Then chime a bell three times near the specified face.

reply.rationale: Most symbols are best treated as whole lexical items: the candidate families based only on shared substrings do not satisfy the evidence requirements for a compositional paradigm. One small procedural paradigm is defensible: FAN-PAIR and FAN-ALL form a minimal pair with the same procedure stem and contrasting scope, and BOARD-PAIR shows the same scope marker with a different procedure stem in the same frame. CLOTH-2EDGE is not supported as segmented because there is no substitutional evidence that 2EDGE is a productive filler or that CLOTH- is a compositional morpheme across a shared frame; it is therefore lexical. This yields an exact partition of all symbols.
